Nina - CS: Quick sync: Novus Health wants a "mini-bootcamp" over two mornings (UTC-8): focus on embeddings behavior and cost controls. Renewal in 8 weeks, current NPS drop in last Q.
Omar - CSM: They asked for small-group labs (max 6 ppl) and a follow-up adoption plan. Can we confirm presenters?
Priya - Enablement: I can do Day 1. Need someone for Day 2 labs.
Leo - SE: Happy to lead Day 2 labs and the office hours. I'll prep a hands-on notebook for embeddings experiments.
Nina - CS: Agenda suggestion: Day 1 (2.5h) intro to embeddings, retrieval best practices, demo + lab. Day 2 (2.5h) cost optimization, batching, and deployment patterns. End each day with 15-min capture of adoption actions.
Priya - Enablement: I'm adding an in-session micro-survey (3 q): confidence, blockers, next-steps. Also will include a sample A/B prompt set for them to run.
Reminder Bot: Reminder set: pre-read due 48h before Day 1 (1768889839).
Omar - CSM: Can we include one exec touchpoint (20m) on Day 2 for renewal cues? If so, I'll coordinate.
Leo - SE: Will include a small diagnostics script to check embedding dims and error rates.
Nina - CS: Cool. Let's finalize by EOD Tue. Priya / Leo ack?
Priya - Enablement: ack :white_check_mark:
Leo - SE: ack :white_check_mark:
Nina - CS: I'll publish invites and the pre-read. We'll track adoption actions in the renewal playbook. Thanks! :sparkles:
